title: Satellite map of industrial activity at sea
summary: A model applied to about 2 million GB of Sentinel-1 radar imagery (2017–2021) maps vessels and infrastructure: about 75% of industrial fishing vessels are not publicly tracked, over 25% of shipping and energy activity is missing from AIS data, wind turbines more than doubled, and global fishing fell 12% during COVID. Published in Nature; ‘fishing’ classification is inferred; source is the organization’s own release.
organization: Global Fishing Watch; University of Wisconsin–Madison, Duke, UC Santa Barbara and SkyTruth

evidence.tested: The page describes no ground-truth check, accuracy metric or comparison for the vessel and infrastructure mapping, so the main claim is not evaluated in the source.
evidence.unknown: Not all boats broadcast their position, the 'fishing' classification is inferred, and the page gives no accuracy figures for that step.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning detected vessels and offshore infrastructure in satellite imagery and inferred which non-broadcasting vessels were likely fishing; the model type is not named.
